info.title: PROJECT NEXUS API
info.description: Control and telemetry API for the NEXUS autonomous mobile robot.

post.description: Stop the robot safely and end the server process (systemd may restart it).
Velocity command; must be repeated at >= 2 Hz or the watchdog stops the robot.
Start autonomous frontier exploration (maps while it explores).

get.description: Recent in-memory telemetry (2 Hz) for charts; older data is in the database.

post.description: Tell the robot where it is on the map (like '2D Pose Estimate' in RViz).
Kidnapped-robot test: move the robot without updating odometry.
Save a ground-truth map of the simulated room (no exploration needed).
